description:
**CODEARAMBH 2.0 👻**

**Where Ideas Come Alive.**

**CODEARAMBH 2.0** is a **24-hour offline hackathon** organized by **TechFusion — the Official Technical & Coding Club of CSE, Hi-Tech Institute of Engineering & Technology (HIET), Ghaziabad**.

Bring your ideas to life, collaborate with fellow innovators, and build a working **prototype/MVP** that solves real-world problems.

**🚀 Tracks**
* 🚚 **Transportation & Logistics**
* 🎓 **Education Technology (EdTech)**
* 🩺 **Healthcare & Wellness**
* 🌱 **Agriculture & Sustainability**
* ✈️ **Travel & Smart Tourism**
* 💡 **Open Innovation**

**⚠️ MANDATORY PPT SUBMISSION**

**PPT submission on the official CODEARAMBH 2.0 portal is MANDATORY for every participating team.**

After completing your Devfolio registration, you **must submit your PPT through the CODEARAMBH 2.0 Main Portal** using the provided template.

🔴 **IMPORTANT:** If your team **does not submit the PPT on the official CODEARAMBH 2.0 Main Portal within the specified deadline, your team will NOT be considered or qualified for the next round.**

**Devfolio registration alone does NOT complete the application process.**

**📌 Required Links**

* 📝 **PPT Submission / Main Portal:** [https://code-arambh.netlify.app/register](url)
* 📊 **Official PPT Template:** [https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1z2cLwrnjljIVhjI1o3lgjOTEXlBXv9Cy/](url)
* 💬 **Official WhatsApp Group:** [https://chat.whatsapp.com/HR09HaxGTWmBiOKdAvwsg4](url)

**Please make sure your PPT follows the official template and is submitted successfully on the main portal before the deadline.**
**🎯 What to Expect**

* 24 hours of building, coding, and innovation
* Hands-on problem solving and collaboration
* Prototype/MVP development
* Mentorship and technical guidance
* Judging by industry and technical experts
* Exciting prizes, certificates, goodies, and recognition

**👨‍💻 Who Can Participate?**

Developers, designers, students, innovators, and tech enthusiasts are welcome to participate and turn their ideas into impactful solutions.

Whether you're an experienced hacker or participating in your first hackathon, **CODEARAMBH 2.0** is your opportunity to build something meaningful.

**🎃 Build. Innovate. Collaborate. Create.**

**Come with an idea. Leave with an innovation.**

**Organized by:** TechFusion, HIET Ghaziabad
**Mode:** Offline
**Duration:** 24 Hours
**Venue:** Hi-Tech Institute of Engineering & Technology, Ghaziabad

**📧 Contact & Important Links**

**Official Email:** [hackathonhiet@gmail.com](url)
**TechFusion Email:** [techfusion@hietgroup.org](url)

**💼 LinkedIn:** [https://www.linkedin.com/company/hiet-techfusion/](url)
**📸 Instagram:** [https://instagram.com/hiet.techfusion](url)

For registration, technical, submission, or event-related queries, participants can contact the organizing team through the official email addresses above.

hackathon_faqs.answer: Yes. CODEARAMBH 2.0 is a 24-hour offline hackathon hosted at Hi-Tech Institute of Engineering & Technology (HIET), Ghaziabad.
hackathon_faqs.question: Is CODEARAMBH 2.0 an offline hackathon?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Yes. All participants must complete their registration on Devfolio. Please follow the official hackathon instructions for any additional registration or submission requirements.
hackathon_faqs.question: Do I need to register on Devfolio to participate?

hackathon_faqs.answer: The top three teams will receive cash prizes of ₹7,000, ₹5,000, and ₹3,000 respectively, along with trophies/medals, certificates, and exclusive goodies and swag.
hackathon_faqs.question: What are the prizes?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Food and refreshments will be provided to participants who qualify for the final offline round, as per the event arrangements.
hackathon_faqs.question: Will food be provided during the hackathon?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Accommodation is not provided. Participants are responsible for arranging their own accommodation if required.
hackathon_faqs.question: Will accommodation be provided?

hackathon_faqs.answer: For any queries, contact us at hackathonhiet@gmail.com or visit https://code-arambh.netlify.app/ for official announcements, instructions, and updates.
